snippet.title: Gran Turismo 2: Project A-Spec mod, Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The release of  the Gran Turismo 2 mod: Project A-Spec is here! Set to "Sabotage" by The Beastie Boys.

Project A-Spec is a mod for Gran Turismo 2 which aims to expand the game with new cars, new events, restored content and overall add fixes.
Download the mod here: https://discord.gg/phawUgASjX

Credits:
Director and car stats: Komputer)

Models and textures: , Komputer, ZED99, HWTsuchiyaNathan, Beastincolt, AndrewA88, TETTE_GROSSE, 32Bit_Bailey, 7Keyz, Tuscan37, Indie101, B_Rad!88

Menu & Logo design: TAIYO, Indie101
